Expected Salary: $42 – $50 per hour

We are looking for a qualified electrician to join our team in Brisbane.

We're after a good tradesman. Someone who turns up on time, works hard, communicates well, takes pride in their work, and wants to help build something properly from the ground up.

We're a new electrical contracting business (started January 2026), doing commercial and industrial work with some residential on the side. We're deliberately not chasing the same job over and over — we partner with good clients across a variety of work and aim to service them end to end. We're a relationship-first contractor, and because we're small, you'll work directly with the owner, not through layers of management.

If you want to be part of something from the start — not just join a business, but help shape one — this is that opportunity.

What We Offer
Tool-for-trade vehicle (likely brand new)
38-hour week with half-day Fridays
Competitive Hourly Rate
Overtime and allowances available
Quality tools and equipment
Direct access to the owner — no chaos, no red tape
Real variety of work through long-term client relationships, not the same job on repeat
The chance to help shape a growing company and grow with it

The Role
You'll be working across a genuine variety of commercial and industrial projects (with some residential), carrying out electrical installation, fit-off, fault finding, testing, maintenance, and general project work. Because we service clients end to end, you'll get exposure to different job types rather than doing the same thing on repeat. As we grow, there's real opportunity to take on more responsibility early — leading jobs, mentoring apprentices, and helping set up how we do things.

What We're Looking For
Current QLD Electrical Licence
Current CPR / LVR
Manual driver's licence
Solid trade experience — early career or experienced both welcome
Strong workmanship and attention to detail
Good attitude and reliable work ethic
Comfortable across a variety of work, not just one type of job
Ability to work well independently and communicate professionally with clients
Pride in presentation, cleanliness, and quality
Someone looking for a long-term role and keen to grow with a company from the start

We don't want big talkers or shortcuts — just a solid electrician who does the job properly and wants to grow with a company that's going somewhere.

About Us
We are a Brisbane-based electrical contracting business specialising in commercial and industrial work. We work across true variety, including:
Water/wastewater utilities — instrumentation, maintenance and construction on pump stations, treatment plants and more
Power station shutdown projects
High-end residential developments
Commercial construction, including fitouts
Switchboard maintenance and breakdowns
Data and air conditioning systems

Our aim is to be a solid, well-rounded electrical contractor with the skilled people to back it up. We're relationship-first — we'd rather do great work for a smaller number of good clients across a genuine variety of jobs than churn through the same repetitive work. As a new business, we're building our team, systems, and reputation from the ground up, with a focus on doing things properly from day one.

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as an electrician?
Do you hold a current electrical licence?
Do you have a current Low Voltage Rescue First Aid accreditation?
Are you licenced to drive a manual vehicle?
Do you have purchasing experience?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Have you completed an electrical qualification?

Position Title: Civil Engineering Draftsperson 
Employment Type:  Full-Time (38 hours per week) 
Primary office work Location: Suite 40, 5-7/200 Kingston Rd, Slacks Creek QLD 4127
Salary: $75,000 + $85,000 + Superannuation per Annum. 

Our client, Radon Pty Ltd T/A Build Fast Constructions Australia, is seeking a dedicated and skilled full-time Civil Engineering Draftsperson to support the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The business is experiencing continued growth within the construction sector and is actively expanding its project portfolio through the acquisition of new developments and infrastructure works. The successful candidate will play a key role in preparing detailed technical drawings, design documentation, and project deliverables to support efficient project execution.

Responsibility
Responsible for preparing detailed drawings, plans, and technical documentation for civil infrastructure, residential, and commercial projects using CAD software such as AutoCAD and Civil 3D. The role involves producing accurate construction drawings, design documentation, quantity take-offs, and revisions while ensuring compliance with engineering standards, project specifications, and construction requirements. 

Key duties:
1.	Assist civil engineers and engineering technologists in preparing detailed drawings, plans, and technical documentation for civil infrastructure projects including residential and commercial projects.
2.	Produce accurate construction drawings, sketches, and working plans using CAD software such as AutoCAD and Civil 3D, ensuring compliance with engineering standards, specifications, and project requirements.
3.	Prepare technical documentation, specifications, and drawing sets to support tender submissions, contract requirements, and construction execution.
4.	Undertake site surveys and collect field data including levels, measurements, and geospatial information to support design development and update existing drawings.
5.	Translate engineering concepts and design sketches into detailed technical drawings suitable for construction and contractor use.
6.	Perform material quantity take-offs and assist in estimating construction requirements based on drawings and design documentation.
7.	Review and revise drawings throughout the project lifecycle to ensure accuracy, compliance, and alignment with engineering changes and site conditions.
8.	Inspect civil works on-site at different construction stages to ensure compliance with approved drawings and report discrepancies or non-conformances to engineers.
9.	Assist in the preparation of drainage, stormwater, road alignment, pavement, and utility service drawings in accordance with Australian Standards and project specifications.
10.	Support the design and documentation of water supply, sewerage, and hydraulic services systems as part of civil infrastructure projects.
11.	Liaise with project engineers, site supervisors, and construction teams to clarify design requirements, respond to RFIs, and ensure correct implementation of drawings.
12.	Maintain accurate drawing registers, revision records, and project documentation systems to ensure proper version control and project compliance throughout construction stages.

Mandatory Requirements: 
AQF comparable Diploma or Higher education
Relevant Minimum 1 Year experience.  
 
Application will be processed by shortlisting the candidates. Kindly apply during the advertisement period from 13 July 2026 to 12 August 2026. Please submit your resume and cover letter outlining the portfolio and experience.

Welcome to Karrara Indian & Mexican Cuisine, where bold flavors and vibrant traditions come together to create a one-of-a-kind dining experience. Located in the heart of Adelaide, we take pride in serving an exceptional fusion of authentic Indian and Mexican dishes, crafted with passion, tradition, and a modern twist.
At Karrara, we believe that food is more than just a meal—it’s a journey. Our chefs bring their expertise, carefully selecting the finest ingredients to ensure every dish bursts with authentic taste and aroma. Whether you crave the rich, aromatic spices of India or the fiery zest of Mexico, our menu offers something to tantalize every palate.
From sizzling Mexican fajitas to flavorful Indian curries, every bite is a celebration of culture and craftsmanship. Whether you dine in, take away, or opt for catering, we are committed to providing a warm, welcoming atmosphere and outstanding customer service.
Come and experience the best of two culinary worlds at Karrara Indian & Mexican Cuisine, where every meal tells a story of tradition, taste, and innovation.
We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, freshly prepared meals to our community and customers. We are seeking a skilled and versatile Chef to join our dynamic team.

Position Overview:
We are looking for an experienced Chef who can manage kitchen operations, prepare a variety of dishes, and uphold our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate will have a broad culinary background and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Duties & Responsibilities:
•	Menu Preparation: Prepare and cook a wide range of authentic Indian and Mexican dishes, including chef specials, non-vegetarian and vegetarian curries, biryanis, tandoori items, Mexican entrees such as tacos, nachos, potato skins, jalapeño poppers, and seafood specials (e.g., smokey lime prawns), ensuring consistency, high quality, and adherence to the restaurant’s signature fusion style
•	Menu Development: Collaborate in developing and updating menus, incorporating seasonal ingredients and customer preferences.
•	Kitchen Management: Oversee daily kitchen operations, ensuring efficient workflow and timely service, Prepare roster for Kitchen team and lead the team from front.
•	Team Leadership: Supervise and train kitchen staff, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
•	Inventory Control: Manage inventory levels, conduct stock takes, and order supplies as needed.
•	Quality Assurance: Maintain high standards of food hygiene, safety, and presentation.
•	Budgeting & Cost Management: Monitor food costs, portion control, and minimize waste to ensure profitability.


Skills & Experience Required:
To be considered for this role, you must meet the following requirements:
•	Qualification: Minimum Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery or an equivalent qualification AQF level or above.
•	Work Experience: Minimum two (2) years or more of Full-Time experience as a Chef in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
•	Culinary Expertise: Proficiency in preparing a variety of cuisines, including BBQ, seafood, and fast-food items.
•	Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a kitchen team effectively.
•	Time Management: Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
•	Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
•	Flexibility: Willingness to work various shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

What We Offer:

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in mechanical maintenance and possess the qualifications needed to perform the tasks effectively and safely.      Benefits   Competitive salary package of $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation.  Full-time, stable employment with a well-established automotive service business.  Opportunity to work with modern diagnostic tools and mechanical equipment. Reassemble mechanical components following technical specifications outlined in service manuals.  To ensure optimal performance and efficiency, perform scheduled maintenance services including oil changes, lubrications, and engine tune-ups.  Ensure compliance with pollution regulations during maintenance services and repairs.  Conduct inspections of vehicles for roadworthiness and issue necessary certifications upon passing.  Test and adjust mechanical systems and components post-repair to ensure proper operation.  Perform tyre fitting, wheel balancing, and other related maintenance services as required.  Utilise specialised tools and equipment to clean and maintain motor vehicle engines.  Refer to service manuals and technical documents for accurate repair procedures.    Qualification & experience   Minimum Certificate IV in Automotive Mechanical Diagnosis or equivalent.  A minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in mechanical repairs, vehicle servicing, and maintenance.  Strong diagnostic and problem-solving abilities.  Proficiency in using mechanical tools and diagnostic equipment.  Attention to detail and commitment to vehicle safety and performance.  Ability to work independently and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.  Knowledge of pollution regulations and safety standards.  Excellent communication skills and the ability to provide clear reports and recommendations.   About Company    City Discount Tyres Malaga is a well-established automotive service and tyre specialist located in Malaga, Western Australia. The business provides a comprehensive range of services, including tyre sales and fitting, wheel balancing, wheel alignments, brake repairs, and general mechanical servicing. Known for its reliable workmanship and strong customer service, the company has built a solid reputation within the local community. With a growing customer base and increasing demand for vehicle servicing, the workshop continues to expand its operations while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and professionalism.
